## Two tasks next week say they are waiting, and neither really is
- Business Foundations has to be decided on the 30th and is marked as waiting on the SBI loan.
The sanction is now dated 10 November, eleven days after the decision is due. If the fee is what that dependency was about, INSEAD will want your answer long before the money lands, so this is a decision to make on its own rather than one to hold.
- The post-MBA statement on the 31st reads Upcoming and has nothing behind it.
Nothing on the board gates it and nobody else is involved. It is an evening's thinking that then decides your electives, your exchange and when you recruit. - Of everything dated next week, it is the one that gets harder the longer it sits.
